newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: STATE COMMERCIAL BANK 5-MO PROFIT 5.9 MLN LTL.
newsitem.headline: STATE COMMERCIAL BANK 5-MO PROFIT 5.9 MLN LTL.

text.p: Lithuania's State Commercial Bank said on Tuesday that its net profit for the first five months of the year was 5.9 million litas compared with 800,000 litas in the same period last year.

The director of the finance and treasury department of the bank Audrone Vaitkiene told Reuters that the bank's assets at the end of May rose to 1.09 billion litas compared to 730 million litas at the beginning of the year.
The bank said earlier its net profit for the first quarter of the year was 281,000 litas.
The loan portfolio of the bank at the end of May was down to 593.1 million litas versus 607.3 million litas at the beginning of 1997, she said.
Vaikiene said that the deposits of the bank have increased and stood at 916 million litas at the end of May compared to 544.8 million litas at the beginning of the year.
Lithuania's State Commercial Bank is one of the two state run banks slated for privatisation by the country's government.
The finance ministry launched last week a tender for the bank's privatisation and is expecting applications to be submitted by July.
Lithuanian Vilniaus and Hermis banks confirmed earlier they were eyeing the Commercial Bank.
